limitations.tdr_guarantee_note: This profile is measurement provenance and Host policy input. It is not a GPU watchdog/TDR certificate. A measured workload does not guarantee safe execution for workloads outside its recorded envelope.

completion_requirements: Replace every required null with a measured value; do not invent or copy values from another adapter/driver combination.
Record exact adapter LUID, vendor/device IDs, driver version, Windows build, Runtime build and shader package SHA-256.
Record the maximum tested workload envelope and exact Runtime Hard Limit values selected by Host policy.
Attach raw timing and memory artifacts with repeat count and measurement timestamp.
Host must verify profile identity against the active environment before passing selected limits to runtime_desc.
